chars.Z: ZOUBIR: a slim 17-year-old boy wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide black stripe across the chest, black jogging trousers and white sneakers.
chars.D: DAD: a middle-aged man wearing a long brown Moroccan djellaba with the hood down over a white undershirt, beige leather slippers.
chars.M: MOM: a woman wearing a lavender headscarf and a long dark green house kaftan with gold trim.
chars.F: FRIENDS: two older teenage boys, both wearing matching red tracksuits and black baseball caps.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night on a small apartment balcony in Casablanca with city lights behind. DAD sits on a white plastic chair smoking a hand-rolled cigarette, grey smoke curling up, looking away guiltily. MOM stands in the balcony doorway with hands on her hips, glaring at him angrily. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daytime in front of a Moroccan public high school in Casablanca with a green gate and palm trees. ZOUBIR walks to school with a backpack, looking grown-up and thoughtful.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Casablanca street corner next to an old wall. The two FRIENDS lean on the wall smoking and laughing with red sleepy eyes. ZOUBIR stands with them looking uneasy.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same street corner. One of the FRIENDS holds out a cigarette to ZOUBIR, ZOUBIR raises his hand to refuse and steps away, determined.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Evening inside a modest Moroccan living room with long sedari couches and patterned cushions. ZOUBIR has just opened the front door and freezes. DAD and MOM sit side by side on the couch facing him with arms crossed, very serious, clearly waiting for him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. MOM stands holding up a big transparent plastic bag full of dried green herbs in one hand and a thick stack of banknotes in the other, shocked and angry. ZOUBIR in front of her with mouth wide open in shock.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. DAD stands pointing his finger angrily at ZOUBIR, shouting. ZOUBIR leans back confused with hands open. MOM behind them holds the plastic bag of herbs, worried.
